snippet.title: Unhomely - Official Teaser Trailer | PC Horror Game 2025
snippet.description:
Unhomely is a retro-inspired first person indie psychological horror game set in New Zealand.

Enjoy your stay at the elusive tech CEO Tom Ballinger's New Zealand cabin. You play a journalist who is keen to get the exclusive scoop on Ballinger's next project. You have 3 days alone in his cabin... can you figure out the secret behind his success.

The game is set to release end of 2025 on Steam for PC.

Wishlist it on Steam today to help our indie team reach more people organically.
